items.title: DuPont (DD) Lands First US Municipal OxyMem Wastewater Project
items.summary: DuPont de Nemours (NYSE:DD) secured the first US municipal deployment of its OxyMem MABR wastewater treatment modules. The OxyMem membrane aerated biofilm reactor technology is being used to support stricter regulatory and decarbonization goals in municipal water systems. The US project is positioned as a scalable option for upgrading aging wastewater infrastructure with lower energy use and smaller physical footprints.
